title: Roundtable Policy: Confidence-Weighted-Consensus Aggregation Improves Multi-Agent-System Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2509.16839v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent systems have demonstrated exceptional performance in downstream tasks beyond diverse single agent baselines. A growing body of work has explored ways to improve their reasoning and collaboration, from vote, debate, to complex interaction protocols. However, it still remains opaque why specific choice would be preferred in multi-agent systems. Inspired by the decision-making mechanism of democratic committees and The Society of Mind, we introduce Roundtable Policy, an inference-time reasoning framework for multi-agent systems that performs inference through the weighted consensus of multiple LLMs. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate its that this approach significantly enhances reasoning in complex heterogeneous scientific tasks. translated_title: 圆桌政策：置信度加权共识聚合提升多智能体系统推理
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统在下游任务中已展现出超越多种单智能体基线的卓越性能。越来越多的研究工作探索了改进其推理与协作的方法，从投票、辩论到复杂的交互协议。然而，为什么在多智能体系统中应优先选择某种特定方法仍然不明确。受民主委员会决策机制和“心智社会”理论的启发，我们提出了圆桌政策，这是一种面向多智能体系统的推理时框架，通过多个大语言模型的加权共识来执行推理。通过大量实验，我们证明该方法能显著增强在复杂异构科学任务中的推理能力。圆桌政策强调结构化且可解释的推理，而非不透明的收敛过程，同时仅需黑盒访问权限和统一流程，因此具有广泛的适用性。
tldr: 本文提出“圆桌政策”推理框架，通过多个大语言模型的置信度加权共识聚合，在仅需黑盒访问的条件下显著提升多智能体系统在复杂科学任务中的推理能力，并兼具结构化与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Roundtable Policy, an inference-time framework that aggregates multiple LLMs via confidence-weighted consensus, significantly improving multi-agent reasoning on complex heterogeneous scientific tasks while requiring only black-box access and remaining structured and interpretable.
